verdict.rationale: Reducto returns every processing result as structured JSON, with tables in several formats, so its outputs are in open formats by default. Lock-in is also limited: under the Zero Data Retention policy, API data expires within 24 hours, and VPC deployments keep all data and storage in the customer's own environment. However, nothing documents an account-level 'export everything' capability. Studio-run jobs and results saved with persist_results are retained, yet the pack shows no way to bulk-export them, or Studio pipeline configurations, before leaving. Missing for 10: a documented bulk or account-wide data export, export of Studio pipelines/configs and persisted results, explicit offboarding/deletion-on-exit documentation, and independent corroboration.
